description.value: A 24/7 McDonald's drive-through and dine-in location in the Kerrisdale neighbourhood of Vancouver, offering the full Canadian McDonald's menu including McCafé beverages. As a round-the-clock fast food stop with drive-through access, it is a reliable resupply point for touring cyclists on long days or early-morning departures. The Kerrisdale location sits near several residential cycling corridors on Vancouver's west side.
